introSave: Reads your save on a timer. XP and gold rates update when the game writes new progress—often up to three minutes apart, sometimes longer.
introLive: Live memory is on — XP, gold, and chest stats update in real time from the running game.
introLiveNoChest: Live memory is on — XP and gold update in real time. Chest drop rates are not available for this game version yet.
rateTipSave: XP/hour updates only when the game writes new XP to the save (often up to 3 minutes apart, sometimes longer). It holds steady between writes instead of decaying.
rateTipLive: XP/hour from live memory reads (~25 updates per second). Rates hold steady between gains instead of decaying. Switching between live and save-only resets the session.
goldTipSave: Gold earned per hour. Counts gold gained only; spending (upgrades, Cube, runes) is ignored, so it's accurate while farming.
goldTipLive: Gold earned per hour from live memory reads. Counts gold gained only; spending is ignored.
chestTipNeedReader: Chest drop rates require the live memory reader. Turn it on in Settings → Live memory (experimental) and keep the game running.
chestTipPending: Live chest drop tracking is not available for this game version yet — XP and gold still update from live memory.
chestTipLive: Drop rates from live memory this session. Common and stage boss chests are tracked separately while the companion is running.
inventoryPredictionTip: Estimates when your unlocked inventory slots fill up. For each chest type you've marked auto-open below, we model a serial auto-open queue: held chests (from your save) drain at their open speed (faster with reduction runes). When live chest tracking is available, session drop rates can add more chests to the queue. Each opened chest uses one inventory slot. We can't detect the in-game auto-open toggle, so set it here — only common and stage boss chests are modeled. Held counts come from the save file and can lag a few minutes after in-game changes.
fillTurnOn: Turn on an auto-open toggle below and play a session to estimate when it'll be full.
heldChestsOne: Includes {{count}} held chest waiting to auto-open.
heldChestsOther: Includes {{count}} held chests waiting to auto-open.
resetTitle: Reset session stats (drops, history, stage runs)
dpsTitle: Damage per second (5-second rolling window from live memory)
aliveTitle: Monsters currently alive on this map
hpMaxTitle: Sum of max HP of all alive monsters (wave health pool)
mobsKilledTitle: Monsters killed on this map — resets when stage changes
damageTitle: Damage dealt on this map — resets when stage changes
saveStatusConnected: Connected and reading your save. Rates update when the game writes progress.
saveStatusWhen: When XP last changed in your save
colRemainingTip: Remaining XP needed to reach next level (level curve minus current exp).
colEtaTip: Estimated time to next level-up at the current rolling XP rate.
remainingMaxLevel: Max level — no further progression defined.
remainingZero: Rate is zero or not yet established.
chestHistoryEmpty: No drops logged yet this session.
closeOverlayTitle: Close mini overlay (app keeps running in the tray)
saveStatusWaiting: Waiting for the first save read...
